name: Airi（愛莉）
description: Airi 原生形态键（eye_mabataki_L、eye_zitome_1_L、mouth_smile_1_L、eyebrow_angry_1_L 等）。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: Airi's native shape keys (eye_mabataki_L, eye_zitome_1_L, mouth_smile_1_L, eyebrow_angry_1_L, ...). Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: eyebrow_up_1_L
channels.note: 眉毛上移（左侧）。最大位移 14.5mm（airi）。整条眉毛上移，会带眉头。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (left). Max displacement 14.5 mm (airi). Whole brow up, the inner brow comes along. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_up_1_R
channels.note: 眉毛上移（右侧）。最大位移 14.5mm（airi）。整条眉毛上移，会带眉头。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up (right). Max displacement 14.5 mm (airi). Whole brow up, the inner brow comes along. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_down_1_L
channels.note: 眉毛下压（左侧）。最大位移 14.8mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (left). Max displacement 14.8 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_down_1_R
channels.note: 眉毛下压（右侧）。最大位移 14.8mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (right). Max displacement 14.8 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_tare_L
channels.note: 眉头上提（左侧）。最大位移 4.9mm（airi）。eyebrow_tare：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (left). Max displacement 4.9 mm (airi). eyebrow_tare: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrow_tare_R
channels.note: 眉头上提（右侧）。最大位移 4.9mm（airi）。eyebrow_tare：眉头上提、眉尾下垂
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (right). Max displacement 4.9 mm (airi). eyebrow_tare: inner brow up, outer brow down

channels.name: eyebrow_angry_1_L
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（左侧）。最大位移 9.5mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (left). Max displacement 9.5 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eyebrow_angry_1_R
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（右侧）。最大位移 9.5mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (right). Max displacement 9.5 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_mabataki_L
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 20.1mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 20.1 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_mabataki_R
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 20.1mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 20.1 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.R, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_zitome_1_L
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（左侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（airi）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (left). Max displacement 2.4 mm (airi)

channels.name: eye_zitome_1_R
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小（右侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（airi）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows (right). Max displacement 2.4 mm (airi)

channels.name: eye_bikkuri_L
channels.note: 睁大眼（左侧）。最大位移 2.3mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.L，取较大者

channels.name: eye_bikkuri_R
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 2.3mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeWiden.R，取较大者

channels.name: eye_under_up_1_L
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（左侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (left). Max displacement 2.4 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.L, the larger wins

channels.name: eye_under_up_1_R
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）（右侧）。最大位移 2.4mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye) (right). Max displacement 2.4 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_a_1
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 11.9mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop / lowerLipDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 11.9 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop / lowerLipDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_u_1
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 7.3mm（airi）
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 7.3 mm (airi)

channels.name: mouth_smile_1_L
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（左侧）。最大位移 2.5mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (left). Max displacement 2.5 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_smile_1_R
channels.note: 嘴角上扬（右侧）。最大位移 2.5mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up (right). Max displacement 2.5 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_sad_1_L
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（左侧）。最大位移 3.3mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (left). Max displacement 3.3 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_sad_1_R
channels.note: 嘴角下垂（右侧）。最大位移 3.3mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down (right). Max displacement 3.3 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_wide_L
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（左侧）。最大位移 3.7mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (left). Max displacement 3.7 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_wide_R
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽（右侧）。最大位移 3.7mm（airi）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider (right). Max displacement 3.7 mm (airi). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: mouth_narrow_L
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（左侧）。最大位移 2.9mm（airi）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (left). Max displacement 2.9 mm (airi)

channels.name: mouth_narrow_R
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄（右侧）。最大位移 2.9mm（airi）
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower (right). Max displacement 2.9 mm (airi)

channels.name: mouth_H_L
channels.note: 抿嘴（嘴角收紧）（左侧）。最大位移 0.9mm（airi）。形变很小（嘴角向内约 0.5mm）
channels.note_en: Lips pressed (corners tightened) (left). Max displacement 0.9 mm (airi). Very small deformation (mouth corner in by about 0.5 mm)

channels.name: mouth_H_R
channels.note: 抿嘴（嘴角收紧）（右侧）。最大位移 0.9mm（airi）。形变很小（嘴角向内约 0.5mm）
channels.note_en: Lips pressed (corners tightened) (right). Max displacement 0.9 mm (airi). Very small deformation (mouth corner in by about 0.5 mm)

channels.name: mouth_up
channels.note: 嘴整体上移。最大位移 2.6mm（airi）。捏脸区的嘴位置键
channels.note_en: Whole mouth up. Max displacement 2.6 mm (airi). Mouth position key from the face-customization keys

channels.name: mouth_down
channels.note: 嘴整体下移。最大位移 2.6mm（airi）。捏脸区的嘴位置键
channels.note_en: Whole mouth down. Max displacement 2.6 mm (airi). Mouth position key from the face-customization keys

channels.name: eye_up
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 5.0mm（airi）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 5.0 mm (airi). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_down
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 3.0mm（airi）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 3.0 mm (airi). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_look_L
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 4.0mm（airi）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 4.0 mm (airi). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: eye_look_R
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 3.6mm（airi）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 3.6 mm (airi). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
